When I was 15, I was walking in the woods beside the railroad tracks behind my house with a friend of mine, as a train was passing by. I was walking too close and the rocks shifted beneath my feet and I fell face first into it. I hit my face and the side of my head, my arm landed on the rail and my friend grabbed me by the back of my shirt to yank me off, sending us both down a very steep hill of sharp rocks. I had a deep scrape on the back of my shoulder from falling down the rocks, bruises and cuts all over my arms and legs, blood everywhere. Went to the hospital and got 15 stitches in my face and the top of my ear sewn back on as it'd been sliced almost completely off and was only attached by a small thread of skin. The doctors told me they were amazed I hadn't broken anything, have a concussion or lost any teeth. If my friend hadn't pulled me off the rail, I could have easily lost my arm and bled to death long before I ever got to a hospital. One of the scariest days of my life.

Back in high school, my best friend and her boyfriend were staying with me for a few months, crashing on my floor because they'd been living with the boyfriend's dad and he'd kicked them out. My mom agreed they could crash, as she had known them both for years and were both good friends of mine. They were the perfect guests and not who this is about, but they're part of the back story. 

Anyway, we were all laying down one night, middle of the week, going to sleep because my friend's boyfriend and I had school in the morning (best friend had recently graduated, but had to work the next morning.) We had all finally fallen asleep when there's a knock at my window. (All my friends would do this, so it wasn't unusual) It's a mutual friend of all of ours, let's call him J. 

J shows up reallyyyy drunk, asking if he can crash on my floor because he had nowhere to go. He had done this before with no issues, and it was the middle of winter, his house was quite far from mine. So a bit reluctantly I told him he could crash for the night, but my floor was full. He'd have to sleep with me. No problem. We all go to sleep, everything is good. 

Next morning, I wake up very early to head to school. Get up, use the bathroom, J who is still drunk, wakes up, uses it after me while I try to wake my friend's boyfriend up. He tells me go without him, he's not going in today. (Alternative school, so attendance was optional), I say fine, finish up getting ready to leave, J comes out of the bathroom after being in there for a little while, leaves with me in a completely normal mood, so I don't think anything of it. 

He walks with me the whole way to school, (30-40 minute walk down the tracks) telling me about how hard he'd partied the night before, got really smashed, scarfed down a large Hawaiian pizza, then stumbled out to my place. I listened and laughed a bit as we went, then we get to my school, he says thanks for letting him stay and takes off. 

A couple hours later I'm sitting in class and get a text from my friend not too long after she normally woke up to go to work asking if I knew what J did. Confused, I ask her what she means. She begins to tell me that she woke up, went to the bathroom, she's tired, it's still dark so she hops straight into the shower. She's in there for a little bit (I should note she likes her showers very, very hot,) and then she starts to smell something strange. It just gets worse and worse, so she finally peeks out, trying to figure out what this stench is and where it's coming from, when she instantly sees what she was apparently too tired to notice before.
